_note: Interface texts of the card and the push notification. To use another summary language, translate the values (keep keys, {placeholders} and emoji) and save the result as ui.json in the repository root. /setup does this for you.

card.title: Email summary
card.reading: Reading the latest summary from your mail…
card.note: Pick your decisions — nothing happens until you press the button below. Everything is reversible: Trash keeps mail for 30 days, labels can be removed.
card.dryNote: Dry run: the triage is real, but no labels were applied.
card.noDoneLabel: The “Keep” button appears after the next run.
card.later: Remind me later: {n} — they come back in the next summary
card.laterDone: stays unread — comes back in the next summary
card.undoHint: Changed your mind? Press “Undo” on the message.
card.actHint: Awaiting a reply or a payment, or has a deadline.
card.checkHint: The triage did not dare to decide these on its own.
card.markedHint: The “{name}” label is already applied. Nothing was deleted — clean up in Gmail whenever you like.
card.markedHintDry: Dry run: the “{name}” label was not applied, this is only a suggestion.
card.noDrafts: No summary yet. It is built every morning — either the run has not happened yet, or it failed.
card.broken: The summary in your mail is damaged — the run wrote something wrong. Run it again.
card.foot: Built by going through conversations one by one, not by keyword search. No links were opened and no attachments were read. The summary refreshes itself every morning.
card.errReauth: Gmail access has expired — reconnect the connector in claude.ai settings.
card.errNotConnected: The Gmail connector is not connected — turn it on in claude.ai settings.
card.errSelection: Several Gmail connectors are connected — choose one.
card.errNotInManifest: This page was not given access to that action.
card.errNoAccess: This page cannot reach your mail here. Open it on claude.ai with your account.
card.errUnavailable: Gmail did not respond, try again.

push.failedBody: The run failed. The previous summary is still there; see the log.
push.testBody: If this arrived as a push, notifications work.
